source_status: Liu arXiv:2509.02950v1 is unrefereed; only the M_{5,8} half is used

claims.statement: Over C, A^*(U_8) is tautological and U_8 has CKgP, after descent from the mu_5-gerbe M'_{5,8} by Canning-Larson Lemma 3.6.

On M_{5,8} minus M^3_{5,8}, the class [M_omega] is tautological of expected Porteous codimension 4. Lower-gonality degeneracy components on the compactification have higher codimension and do not affect this class.
Normalized sequence (10) gives c(G)=c(L^vee tensor f_* omega_f); with c_1(L)=2 psi_i on M_omega this proves Liu Corollary 3.6.
The load-bearing fact is that BGL_4 -> BG is a representable A^4-bundle; Canning-Larson Lemma 3.5 then gives CKgP of BG from CKgP of BGL_4. Liu's ordinary Chow-ring isomorphism is not enough.

Liu Proposition 3.3 is an open immersion of stacks: over G(3,E) the universal net cuts out a relative complete intersection C, C cap PF is finite flat of degree 8 on an open, and p_8 is the residual degree-1 section after removing the seven given sections.
A^*(M_omega) is generated by restrictions of tautological classes, and M_omega has CKgP. Liu Lemma 3.8 should be read as -psi_i, not 3 psi_i.
Canning-Larson Lemma 9.9 applies at g=5, n=8 (n=8 <= g+7=12) and supplies CKgP of M^3_{5,8} together with tautologicality of classes supported on it.
Excision and Canning-Larson Lemma 3.4 glue L1, L6, L7 to A^*(M_{5,8})=R^*(M_{5,8}) and CKgP of M_{5,8}.
CLP Lemma 4.3 identifies W_24 H^{24} with the cycle-class image of A^{12}=R^{12}. Ionel Theorem 0.1 kills that cohomological image at degree 12; Chow vanishing of R^{12} is not used.
